notes: pairs_with is many-valued in the catalogue; the record's questions presuppose one partner per base in DNA (related_near's chain says functional), so Func(pairs_with) is a firm background fact (README: one-value presupposition). The stored 'guanine pairs with cytosine' gives way (gives_up): with one partner, guanine's partner is now adenine. Letters T and G are surfaces of thymine and guanine (no catalogued abbreviation relation). GC content is the class GcBase. 'Replaced by uracil in RNA' is encoded as the DNA partner not being part of RNA (thymine is not in RNA, a stored background fact; guanine is).

bridge_refs.gc_content: GC content is the share of a DNA molecule's bases that are guanine or cytosine.
